panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the galley branch regulator cabinet and points to low pressure while Mira retrieves the sensor history beside him. The Liaison stays behind the safe work line.
PANEL 2 — Mira logs readings while Zib safely isolates the sticking actuator; they keep their tools and data separate.
PANEL 3 — Astra asks the team whether the visitor should return to the lab as access is blocked. The local sink branch is isolated without shutting down the whole galley.

PANEL 4 — The Operations Liaison answers Astra from behind the safety tape: they would rather observe the real crew response if they are not in the way. Keep it a two-person exchange outside the work zone.
PANEL 5 — Zib marks the stay-behind-this-line boundary as the station notice takes only Galley Sink Two offline. The repair is small, safe and legible, not a wide station crisis.
PANEL 1 — Zib isolates the galley actuator while Jax hands him the correctly tipped driver; the isolation tag is clear.
PANEL 2 — Jax makes room for the service cart and answers Zib's familiar complaint about worn tools. Do not expand the working pair into a crew lineup.
PANEL 3 — Mira compares commanded and actual actuator response beside the open cabinet, joking about the screwdriver history without interfering with Zib's work.
PANEL 4 — Zib takes off the actuator cover while Pixa confirms that the access route around the repair remains open; Pixa is at a separate status station, not holding the tool.
PANEL 5 — The Operations Liaison watches the practiced repair from outside the barrier and remarks on how naturally the crew works together. Pixa's elapsed timer remains incidental in the background.
PANEL 6 — Astra watches Zib and Jax at work and answers the Liaison's observation with a dry distinction between their optional arguments and essential competence.

summary: During the galley regulator repair, each coworker holds a distinct function while the visiting liaison observes. Zib isolates and opens the actuator, Jax keeps access clear, Mira records physical readings, Pixa reports clearance and the Liaison notices the crew's practiced teamwork.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — At the isolated actuator, Zib reseats the track and asks Jax, beside him, to hold the removed cover. Mira's reader stays visible beyond their tools.
PANEL 2 — Jax holds the service cover as Mira photographs the actuator seal, not anybody's hands. The access cart is safely parked behind the service boundary.
PANEL 3 — Glorp files the actual isolation notice while Kreeb posts a plain sign at the unavailable sink. Both do their separate small jobs in one compact two-shot.

PANEL 4 — The Liaison, behind the safety line near Astra, notices that nobody has treated the visitor as the central event. Their remark follows the completed distribution of tasks; no invented direction question or reply.

summary: Galley branch service continues with clear individual ownership: Zib and Jax work the actuator, Mira documents the seal, Glorp records isolation, Kreeb marks sink access and the Liaison sees the distributed response rather than a contrived team portrait.
